tools_list.name: list_toolsets
tools_list.description: List all available toolsets with names and descriptions.

tools_list.name: describe_toolset
tools_list.description: Get detailed information about a toolset including all tool names, descriptions, and input schemas.

toolset_name.description: Name of the toolset to describe. Use list_toolsets to see available names.

tools_list.name: call_tool
tools_list.description: Call a tool by name. Provide toolset_name to call a toolset tool, or omit it to call a top-level MCP tool. Use list_toolsets and describe_toolset to discover available tools and their input schemas.

toolset_name.description: Optional. Name of the toolset containing the tool. Omit to call a top-level MCP tool. Use list_toolsets to discover toolset names.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool to call, without toolset prefix. Use describe_toolset to discover tool names and input schemas.

arguments.description: Arguments to pass to the tool. Must match the tool's input schema. Defaults to an empty object.

list_toolsets_raw: - ToolsetRegistry.AgentSkillToolset: Provides tools for listing, reading, and creating/updating skills.
